purpose: hosted exploration only: synthetic experiments, licence-cleared public alternative datasets, architecture profiling, pretraining and representation probes, and CPU/GPU environment audits. Not installed and not enabled; this file records what it would be if Arya Arun enables it.
competition_data: never. The corpus is not placed in Drive or in consumer Colab, and no competition byte leaves this machine through this profile.
why_e07_stays_on_kaggle: consumer Colab runtimes are ephemeral and its hardware is not guaranteed, per Google's own FAQ. Kaggle already has the verified competition-data mount, the published metric wheelhouse and a measured retrieval path.
escalation: if Google-hosted competition training ever becomes necessary, the route is Colab Enterprise with controlled networking and a separate data-processing review, not this profile.

colab.note: The server runs locally and drives a Colab session in the browser, so enabling it gives an agent a networked remote runtime. That is why this profile is disabled by default and why every result it could produce carries the networked_runtime taint.
